exposure.needed: whether the environment uses AWS Route53 for DNS-01 record deletion and Route53 returns not-found errors during those deletions at runtime

consequence.statement: For environments using AWS Route53, deletion of DNS records now correctly detects not-found errors, so the record-deletion/cleanup path behaves differently than in the previous release when Route53 reports a not-found error during deletion.
consequence.remediation: No operator action stated; verify Route53 DNS-01 challenge cleanup completes normally after upgrading.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 fixes detection of AWS Route53 not-found errors during deletion of DNS records, changing the runtime behavior of DNS record cleanup for environments using Route53.
